component.name: Bosu
component.summary: Follow your rehabilitation at your own pace
Acompaña tu rehabilitación a tu ritmo

description.p: Bosu is a private, local rehabilitation journal for the GNOME desktop. Record complete or partial sessions, rest, and how your body feels.
Mark sensations on a body map, compare reported intensity over time, and export an animation to review your records. Your notes and routines stay on your device.

ul.li: Partial sessions and rest are part of your process.
Link before and after body maps to a session.
Recover drafts and export complete backups.
Keep pain and effort as separate, optional measurements.

description.p: Reliable local storage, partial sessions, linked body maps, draft recovery and GNOME integration.
